name: ColorSwatch
summary: A round sample of a colour, with a thin inner ring so a colour the same as the background still shows, and a checkerboard under a transparent colour. With options, a group of swatches to pick one from (a closed palette).

a11y.apg: Alone, an image (role=img) named by label or the colour value. With options (the picker variation, ADR-0069), a radio group: one native radio button per colour, named by the option's label or the code; the browser gives single choice and the arrow keys.
a11y.keyboardNote: Alone, not interactive. With options, Tab enters the group at the chosen colour, the arrows move and choose, Space chooses — all from the browser's radio buttons.

props.name: color
props.description: REQUIRED without options. Any CSS colour: hex (#f0c200), a name, the CSS colour functions (rgb(), hsl(), oklch(), color()…) or var(--primary). Anything else (with ;, braces, quotes, a comment or url()) is not written into the style.

props.name: size
props.description: 16, 24, 32, 36, 40 — the reference library's scale. Round only (Victor's decision); the checkerboard shows only under a transparent colour.

props.name: label
props.description: The name a screen reader announces ("Aurea yellow"); without it, the colour value. With options, the name of the group ("Accent colour"), and REQUIRED.

props.name: options
props.description: The picker variation (ADR-0069): the colours to pick from, as a colour string or {color, label?, disabled?}. Turns the swatch into a radio group; a disabled option cannot be chosen.

props.name: name
props.description: With options, REQUIRED: the group's name in a form, and what makes the swatches one group (the arrows move between them).

props.name: value
props.description: With options: the chosen colour, controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: With options: the colour chosen at the start.

props.name: onChange
props.description: With options: the browser's event, as in Radio — event.target.value is the chosen colour.

props.name: layout
props.description: With options: in a wrapping row (grid) or in a column (stack), as in the reference.

props.name: indicator
props.description: With options: the mark of the chosen colour, in place of the check (an Icon, for example). It takes the ink that contrasts most.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: With options: each colour's name under it (its label, or the colour value), like the reference's theme picker. The whole item picks; the name is only for the eyes — the radio already has it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: With options: no colour can be chosen.

props.name: id
props.description: With options: the id of the group.
